craft_notes: Sthāyin: self-abiding-abides (senses left; the doubled verb: svātmana...avasthitam — abiding abides). Rows: row 3 (left→abides). Close: abides (the doubled verb closes on itself: abiding ABIDES). Rejected: 'withdraw the senses' — killed: senses-left kept (the leaving, not a technique); 'rests in itself' — killed: self-abiding kept (the verse's own compound doubled).

lines: Sense-doored all, meeting pleasure pain and such:
senses left — self-abiding in own self abides.
l4.sanskrit_cite: indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate

reads_against.argmap: What happens to the senses? → Leaving the sense-doored meetings, one abides self-abiding in own self.
c1_essence: Senses left: self-abiding abides in own self.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness that ends in sovereignty)
